subject: general
question:
Read the sentence carefully and select the synonym of the underlined word from the given alternatives.

Everyone revered my __austere__ father who was the high priest of the famous Shiva temple.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"austere"** means severe or strict in **manner, attitude, or appearance.** (कठोर)

 
 
• **Example: **The teacher's **austere **demeanor made the students take the class very seriously.
 
 
 
• **"Stern" **refers to someone who is serious and unrelenting, especially in the **assertion of authority and discipline.** (कठोर)
 
 
• **Example: **The **stern** look on his face discouraged anyone from speaking out of turn.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'austere' **is **'stern'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aged **(वृद्ध): Being old or advanced in years.

 
 
• **Example:** The **aged** man walked slowly with the help of a cane.
 
 
 
• **Composed **(शांत): Having one's feelings and expression under control; calm.
 
 
• **Example: **She remained** composed** even during the crisis.
 
 
 
• **Morose** (उदास): Sullen and ill-tempered.
 
 
• **Example:** He became **morose** after hearing the bad news.
